programs.name: The American Chestnut Foundation — Georgia Chapter
programs.what: Restoration Chestnut 1.0 — landowner participation in test plantings. Process: TACF national membership → Potential Orchard Steward form → develop stewardship plan with GA Science Coordinator → germplasm agreement → plant. Smaller path: pure American chestnut seedlings at the annual spring sale. Chapter explicitly recommends a few years of membership + volunteering before planting. Multi-year commitment; survival not guaranteed ("many trees today may not carry sufficient disease resistance"). Contact: gachapter@tacf.org, (828) 281-0047. Landowner intro: https://tacf.org/ga-news/so-you-want-to-plant-some-chestnuts/

programs.name: Hemlock Restoration Initiative + GFC HWA Program
programs.what: HWA treatment protocols (imidacloprid + dinotefuran soil drench) for existing hemlocks — DIY-friendly with care, instructions at savehemlocksnc.org/info-for-landowners/landowner-treatment/. Resistant-stock plantings for forest restoration are NOT yet available to landowners (early-stage research). Two ornamental landscape cultivars ('Traveler', 'Crossroads') coming "in the near future" but not yet released. Contact for availability inquiries: 828-252-4783, info@savehemlocksnc.org. GFC HWA: https://gatrees.org/hemlock-woolly-adelgid-hwa-in-georgia/
